bosses.name: Yuri
bosses.strategy:
so heal the survivor immediately. Yuri has quite a bit of HP, and hits
harder than anyone else thus far, so healing will be your immediate
priority.

After just about 400 HP worth of damage, Yuri will fuse into the Death
Emperor, starting to use Dark Messenger. As long as you have Leonardo's
Bears equipped, you won't die instantly, but you'll still be hit pretty
hard. Again, to reiterate: healing will be your immediate priority. Have
two people healing, if needed.

For the first round, have Alice cast Holy Edge on Keith to add a Light
class to his attack, then devote Alice to healing. There most likely
won't be a round where she can attack, but if you can, then use Blessed
Light. Zhuzhen should be using Corpse Arm every round, and Keith should
be attacking normally every round, with his weapon laced with Holy Edge.
Whoever is doing the least amount of damage needs to be helping Alice
heal if it's needed.

Like the last few battles, it'll probably take long enough that you'll
need to replenish your MP and SP as well. Again, have whoever is doing
the least amount of damage take care of this.

bosses.name: Fox Face
bosses.strategy:
He won't fuse into the Death Emperor this time, but he'll still use his
!!! attack. When he does, IMMEDIATELY use a Thera Seed, and DON'T even
try to hit the 'Perfect!!' mark; just get Yuri away from 1 HP, and you'll
be fine.

Fuse into either the Raging Tiger or Inferno (with Fighting Spirit) and
just start wailing away on him with physical attacks. Just keep trading
blows, using Thera Seeds to heal whenever your HP starts to get low, and
ESPECIALLY after the !!! attack.

Make your way inside the castle like you did before. When you reach the fork
with the Save Point, head west, then approach the door to the west that was
previously locked. Keith will unlock it for you, and you'll be able to continue
on. As soon as you enter the stairwell, open a hidden chest to your left for a
[_SEAL OF SPEED_], then start climbing the stairs.

Go up the first set here to the next area, then up another to the next, where
you can go inside a room to your left. In this room, open the chest in the cell
on the left for a [_PURE ROOT_], then go back out and continue climbing the
stairs.

Head up five (or six, depending on where you started counting) more screens to
find another room. Check on the floor in the cell on the left for a
[_LOTTERY TICKET_], and open the chest in the cell on the right for some
[_HEADGEAR_]. Make your way back out.

Go up another five or six screens to another room. Check on the floor in the
cell on the left for a [_TENT_], and check on the floor in the cell on the
right for a [_SEAL OF FORCE_]. Make your way back out, then continue climbing
the stairs. Keep on going, and you'll eventually reach the top of the tower.
Use the Save Point here.

  NOTE     The next boss can use Instant Death, so make sure to equip
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   Leonardo's Bears to everyone.

When you're ready, enter the door for a scene. As much as you don't want to,
you have to fight our long-lost friend.

to talk to the Masks. Once they're done, go through the gate to the north and
watch the events unfold there. You'll then have to face Fox Face one last time,
as Yuri.

After the battle, watch the very long sequence of events. Eventually, you'll be
able to choose your party. I'll go with Yuri, Alice, and Keith for the time
being. Before you know it, you'll be back in the forest at the entrance to the
Blue Castle.

HOWEVER... if you paid attention, you saw something glowing behind Yuri as they
left the tower, so let's go get it. Make your way back into the Castle, through
the western door, and to the very tip top of the tower into the room where you
fought Yuri. Examine the floor on the left side of the room to find the
[_DARK GRAVESTONE_], which will allow you to fight and fuse into Yuri's level 3
Dark Fusion when you have enough Soul Energy! Score!

After you have that, make your way back to the exit and to the World Map. Your
next stop will be Prague.

  NOTE     Even though you didn't see it, you accumulated Soul Energy while
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   Yuri was out of your party, so there's a chance that he has one or
           more new level 2 Fusions that you'll be able to fight and try out.

  NOTE     If you don't have your level 2 Earth or Light Fusions yet, then I
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   recommend heading back inside and fighting until you get them.
